name: adhocracy+
tagline: Makes digital democracy easy — for everyone, no matter where.
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 - Peace Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: dependent on Liquid Democracy e.V. sustainability
news_articles: Participatory budgeting initiatives in Berlin using adhocracy+ (German media coverage)

academic_citations.title: Collaborative adhocracies and mix-and-match technologies in emergency management
The Chaos of Humanitarian Aid: Adhocracy in the Republic of Georgia

policy_outcomes.description: Used for citizen budget (Kiezkasse) processes in Berlin, enabling residents to submit and vote on local spending proposals.

outcome_methodology: Participatory budgeting outcomes tracked through voting participation rates and proposal implementation; formal impact evaluation not published
published_performance_metrics: Participation metrics available through deployed instances; no centralized public performance dashboard
documented_limitations: German-language primary focus limits international adoption
platform enables participation but outcome attribution not documented publicly
failure_modes: low citizen turnout on digital platforms
curation_criteria: AGPL-3.0 open source license; contributions reviewed by Liquid Democracy e.V. development team; no formal contribution standards documented
contributor_governance: Open source contributions welcome; AGPL-3.0 licensed; no formal contributor governance documented
disparity_tracking: No documented equity or inclusion metrics; language barriers noted as limiting accessibility
community_ownership: Community contributions accepted via GitHub; primary governance and decision-making remains with Liquid Democracy e.V.
ai_involvement: No AI or machine learning components identified in platform architecture
